Thanks again for the call today — great to learn more about NovaFlow's roadmap. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment:

- Usage profile you shared: ~20M tokens/month initially, expected to grow to ~60M tokens/month over 9–12 months. Mix: ~70% generation (chat/completions), ~30% embeddings.
- Latency SLO: 95th < 400ms regionally (US), high reliability required for customer-facing assistant.
- Key asks: confirm target unit economics ($/1M tokens), startup discount eligibility, and committed-use options for predictable pricing.

What I can provide now: a baseline cost breakdown + two pricing paths (startup program vs committed-use). Please confirm the volume assumptions below or flag any adjustments.

Baseline list pricing (for reference):
- Redwood-Gen-1 (generation): $1,200 per 1M tokens (list)
- Redwood-Embed-1 (embeddings): $150 per 1M tokens (list)

Using the 70/30 mix at 20M tokens/month, weighted list cost ≈ $ (0.7 * $1,200 + 0.3 * $150) = $ (840 + 45) per 1M = $885 per 1M. Monthly bill at 20M = ~$17.7k (list).

Startup program (what we discussed):
- Standard startup benefit: 30% off list for first 12 months + $25k platform credit (subject to eligibility).
- Effective for NovaFlow (if eligible): $885 * 0.7 = example — see committed vs startup below for consolidated numbers.

Committed-use tiers (examples):
- 3-month commit (250k tokens/day avg) -> ~10% off list
- 12-month commit ($1M/month nominal) -> ~25% off list
- 24-month multi-year -> additional 5% on top of committed tier (applied after tier discount)

Proposed next steps:
1) Can you confirm expected month-1, month-6, and month-12 token volumes (so I can model effective $/1M by month)?
2) Confirm whether NovaFlow meets startup eligibility (pre-Series B, < $5M ARR, standard investor list). If yes, I can apply startup package in parallel.
3) If you prefer a committed quote, I’ll draft a commercial proposal and loop in Legal for an expedited MSA + DocuSign.

Attachments: Redwood_Startup_Program_Summary.pdf (summary of startup benefits), usage_estimate_novaflow.csv (simple model).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 20-min call tomorrow to walk the numbers.

Best,

Great questions — answering inline and then a short proposed commercial path.

1) Monthly cost examples (list pricing):
- At 20M tokens/month (70/30 gen/embed): weighted list $/1M = $885 -> monthly ≈ $17,700
- At 60M tokens/month (same mix): monthly ≈ $53,100

2) Startup program mechanics:
- 30% off list applied across product lines (generation + embeddings).
- $25k credit is a billing credit applied to invoices (not extra free VMs). Credits consume before invoicing.
- Eligibility: typical startup criteria (pre-Series B, investor list). If you confirm eligibility I’ll start the enrollment flow.

3) Committed-use + multi-year + startup stacking:
- Committed 12-month tier example: 25% off list.
- Multi-year add-on: additional 5% off (applied after committed discount).
- Startup program: typically we don’t stack full startup + committed discounts. Standard approach is either: a) apply startup package (30% off for first 12 months + $25k credit) OR b) apply committed pricing (25% + 5% multi-year) which often results in a larger discount at higher volumes. However, for strategic partners we can consider a hybrid (e.g., small promo top-up) subject to Sales Ops approval.

Numeric examples (generation list $1,200 / embeddings list $150):
- 12-month committed only (25%): generation -> $900/1M; embeddings -> $112.5/1M; weighted at 70/30 -> $ (0.7*900 + 0.3*112.5)= $ (630 + 33.75)= $663.75/1M
- 12-month committed + multi-year (25% then 5% on discounted price -> net 28.75% off): generation -> $856.50/1M; embeddings -> $106.69/1M; weighted -> ~$ (0.7*856.5 + 0.3*106.69)= $ (599.55 + 32.01)= $631.56/1M
- Startup 30% off list: generation -> $840/1M; embeddings -> $105/1M; weighted -> $ (0.7*840 + 0.3*105)= $ (588 + 31.5)= $619.5/1M (for first 12 months)

So for your volumes, the economics look like: at 20M/month:
- List: ~$17.7k/mo
- Startup 30%: ~$12.4k/mo (plus $25k credit applied)
- Committed 12-month (25%): ~$12.5k/mo (very similar)
- Committed + multi-year (approx net 28.75%): ~$12.6k/mo (slightly better effective $/1M than pure committed at scale)

Suggested commercial path for NovaFlow (to move quickly):
Option A — Startup route (fastest): enroll NovaFlow to the startup program (30% off for 12 months + $25k credit). I can get this approved quickly if you confirm eligibility.
Option B — Committed route (lowest long-term unit cost): 12-month $1M/month commit with multi-year increment (approved discounts can get you to ~ $632/1M effective). This requires a signed MSA/commit and Sales Ops approval for the multi-year add-on.

I’ve attached a 1-page commercial proposal (commercial_proposal_novaflow.pdf) with both options side-by-side.

Next ask from us: can you confirm eligibility for the startup program and let me know which option Finance prefers? If Option B, I’ll loop in Ben (copied) to fast-track discount authorization and Legal for DocuSign.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call to walk the numbers.

Best,
Marissa
